author: piztanza
description: Implement the landing page's full approved 13-band section stack (F-001) plus the hero headline rotation (F-003) and waitlist CTA wiring (F-009) on route /. All copy verbatim from the approved EN/ID TXT maps (source of truth: .ba/discovery/design-reference/Mobeeli Landing.dc.html); brand tokens per design/style.json; scroll reveal with reduced-motion fallback; official logo variants (blue on light, white on dark). The 3D scene areas (F-002 fitment wheel, F-006 Indonesia map) and the AI-catalog animation loop (F-005) ship as styled static containers in this change and are implemented by their own subsequent changes.
acceptance_criteria: All 13 sections render on / in the approved order with approved copy in both EN and ID
Brand tokens match design/style.json (Plus Jakarta Sans self-hosted, #2f7df6 palette, #0d1522 dark surfaces, 18px card radii, pill buttons)
Sticky nav anchors scroll to sections with 84px scroll-margin offset; nav + Early Adaptors CTAs link to /join
Hero H1 rotates the four approved phrase pairs per language every ~3.4s with slide transition, min-height reserved (no layout shift), paused under reduced motion
Language toggle switches every string on the page instantly, persists via localStorage 'mobeeli-lang', and updates the html lang attribute
Buyer strip and Investors CTAs use the approved mailto addresses and subjects; founder direct emails listed
Floating hero cards render over the scene container (part card, fit pill, unify-graph video card with muted looping lazy video)
Scroll-reveal staggered animations run on section entry and are disabled under prefers-reduced-motion
Official logos used: mobeeli-logo-blue.png on light surfaces, mobeeli-logo-white.png on dark surfaces
Existing test suite stays green; new tests cover the rotation timing config and i18n key completeness for all landing keys
